title: Pair of 608 bearing blocks
prompt: Pair of bearing blocks to carry an 8 mm shaft on two 608 bearings (22 mm OD, 7 mm wide). Each block has a 60 x 20 x 5 mm foot plate with two M5 clearance holes (5.5 mm), 44 mm apart on the foot's centre line, and an upright standing on the foot: 40 mm wide, 8 mm thick along the shaft, with a rounded top whose edge is a half circle centred on the shaft. The bearing seat is a 22.1 mm hole through the upright, centred 25 mm above the bottom of the foot. The blocks are 100 mm apart centre to centre. Put the shaft axis along Y at X = 0, Z = 25, the first block centred on Y = 0 and the second on Y = 100, feet on Z = 0.

hidden_tests.description: Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid
Four bodies: a foot and an upright per block
Feet on Z = 0, first block's foot from Y = −10, centred on X
Second block's foot to Y = 110; the rounded tops reach Z = 45 (25 + 20)
Two 22.1 mm bearing seats (22.0–22.3, press fit for a 22 mm 608) on the shaft axis X = 0, Z = 25
Two uprights, 40 wide x 8 thick, standing 40 mm tall from the top of the foot to the top of the arch
The second upright is centred 100 mm along the shaft from the first (Y = 100)
Two 60 x 20 x 5 mm feet on Z = 0
Two M5 clearance holes (5.3–5.6 mm) per foot, 44 mm apart on its centre line

notes: 608: 8 x 22 x 7. 22.1 mm seat = light press fit when printed. Upright arch radius 20 leaves 8.95 mm of material around the seat at the top and the bottom.
